title: artifact cites

setup.note: Two claims carry the constraints — the budget (ev_budget) and the dates (ev_dates). The model world_reads them, fetches both listings and writes the comparison. It also cites one page it never opened; code drops that citation.

spaces.label: Goa trip with Rohan in December

prepared.intent: comparing villas in Anjuna for 18-21 Dec

https://villas.example/sol: Villa Sol — 5400 per night, pool, 6 beds, free cancellation till Dec 1
https://villas.example/casa: Casa Anjuna — 6100 per night, no pool, 4 beds, non-refundable

criteria: 2 listings on price, pool, beds, cancellation

artifact.title: Anjuna villas, 18-21 Dec, 4 people
artifact.body:
| villa | price | pool | cancel |

input_events: One prepared action of kind compare with the budget and the dates already claimed in the world model.

expected.note: The table lists the source URLs it actually fetched and the events that set budget and dates. A citation to a page the run never opened is dropped, not trusted.
